effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.) and ＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.) until your opponent's turn ends.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 [ADVENTURE] trait card with a play cost of 4 or less from your trash without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] You may play 1 [ADVENTURE] trait card with a play cost of 4 or less from your trash without paying the cost.
xros_req: [Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[Greymon] in name or w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 3
